title: Summarize project state
notes:
Project state as of 2026-06-27 (branch main, HEAD 3e97972 "bd init").

WORKING TREE: 401 modified files, but ~390 are pure CRLF/LF line-ending churn
(0 line changes) from editing on Windows -- noise, not real work. 259 untracked
files, mostly akao/ test artifacts (test.mid/.events, *.log, throwaway check_*.py)
and ROM/binary blobs (gradius3.zip, mainrom.bin, c64 dumps) that should not be committed.

REAL UNCOMMITTED WORK is in akao/ (~1800 +/773 -):
- Volume-handling refactor: new MidiRenderStrategy pattern in format_base.py
  (VelocityStrategy, ExpressionStrategy, CC7Strategy + create_render_strategy factory),
  linear_to_midi() volume conversion, ROM-table loader helpers.
- format_psx.py heavily reworked (+543/-416): new Pass2State dataclass consolidating
  Pass 2 state, opcode dispatch table, patch resolution.
- format_snes.py reworked (+333/-350) to match.
- ir_events.py: new make_volume / make_volume_fade / make_unknown IR factories.
- New/expanded YAML configs: chrono_cross, ff7, ff8, ff9 (per-song metadata + render
  strategy selection); minor sd3/ff2 tweaks.
Continues the "volume work / normalization / initial ff7 support" thread from recent commits.

Minor real changes outside akao: psx/cc/listfat.pl (+25), psx/ff9/ff9mus.pl (+2),
snes/gradius3/g3mus.pl, snes/ff3/ff3spc.dis.

NEXT STEPS: (1) decide line-ending policy (.gitattributes / core.autocrlf) before the
CRLF churn pollutes a commit; (2) add .gitignore for akao test artifacts + ROM blobs;
(3) commit the akao volume-strategy refactor as a focused commit.
close_reason: Project state summarized; notes recorded on issue
